objective: Prove the shipped 0.1.2-1 behavior works for real with the built CLI, not only in tests: migrate on real-shaped legacy trees, the SessionStart hook in each case, and assignment dispatch with --input.
scope: Built CLI: packages/integrations/claude/dist/scripts/holyagent (rebuild with mise run build only if missing)
Work in throwaway copies under /tmp/holyagent-validation, never in this repository's .holyagent/
constraints: Install mise and the toolchain mise.toml pins if missing (outside the repo), then run mise run verify on the current head.

For holycodex state, use fixtures from github.com/davidbasilefilho/holycodex (packages/core/src/work-state.ts schemas) if reachable, else generate a tree matching those schemas; for .holyclaude use the shapes packages/runtime/tests/migrate.test.ts encodes plus a hand-varied copy.
Drive the hook with the payload fields Claude Code sends to SessionStart (look them up in the hook code and docs/hooks.md); cover agent_type absent and agent_type holyagent.

Run each CLI call twice: once with stdin from /dev/null and once with stdin an open pipe that never closes (for example sleep 30 | holyagent ...  under timeout 10), and report whether --input blocks in the second case.

Keep working until everything asked is done; stop to ask only when you cannot go on. When done and checked, stop and report; do not add unrequested features, files or refactors. Make no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/. Do not fix anything: report each failure with the exact command, exit code and output excerpt.
Name any check you could not run and why; a syntax-only check or one that failed to start does not count.

criteria.text: mise run verify: command, exit code and pass/fail counts on the current head
migrate --dry-run then migrate on a .holyclaude tree and on a .holycodex tree: counts, unconvertible records with reasons, then status and assignment list --all reload cleanly
migrate refuses a second run over existing records and stops on a Running Assignment with a hint, exit codes shown

hook session-start output for: plain session with .holyagent/ (core rules plus takeover line), only .holyclaude/ (migrate notice plus rules), session started as holyagent (no core block), no folder (empty)
intent create, assignment create and assignment dispatch with --input run end to end in a scratch project, with stdin closed and with stdin an open pipe; malformed JSON gives an error and hint

result:
result: 4 of 5 blocking criteria pass on the built 0.1.2-1 CLI. The fifth fails in one sub-case: with stdin an open pipe that never closes, every `--input` command blocks until killed (exit 124). Nothing was fixed.
changed: none in the repository. Scratch lives under /tmp/holyagent-validation (fixtures, work copies, mise at /tmp/holyagent-validation/mise-bin/mise). `mise trust` wrote only mise's user state.

- `mise run verify` (head 2030405, canary bun 1.4.4-canary.1+a8fcd319b) -> exit 0. check: "No type errors in 97 files"; lint: "No problems in 98 files"; fmt:check: "All 210 files are formatted"; test: 760 pass, 1 skip (plugin.test.ts "claude CLI is not installed" branch), 0 fail, 761 tests in 25 files.
- `migrate --dry-run` / `migrate` on holyclaude clean tree -> 0 / 0; 3 intents, 5 assignments, 3 notes; reloaded 3/5. `status` 0, `intent list` 0, `assignment list --all` 0 (5 rows).
- holyclaude unconvertible tree -> dry-run 0 lists 2 records: `Expected no excess property at ["owner"]` and `Expected "Ready" | ... at ["state"]`; migrate -> 3, nothing written.
- holycodex clean tree -> dry-run 0, migrate 0, reloaded 2 intents / 7 assignments; `status` 0, `intent list` 0, `assignment list --all` 0 (7 rows). holycodex unconvertible `owner Reviewer.plan is not a holyagent route` -> migrate 3.

- `intent create`, `assignment create`, `assignment dispatch --input` in scratch projects -> 0 with stdin /dev/null and with a pipe that closes after 2s (dispatch of a Ready id and of a new draft both Running). Malformed JSON -> 2, `error: InvalidDraft: --input: Expected a valid JSON string`, `hint: Send JSON in the shape ...`. Unknown field -> 2.
- Never-closing pipe (`sleep 30 |` under `timeout 10`): intent create 124, assignment create 124, malformed intent create 124 (no error, since stdin is read before parsing), assignment dispatch 124. No `.holyagent` created.
- Every payload-free call also run with never-closing stdin: migrate --dry-run, migrate (holyclaude and holycodex), status, assignment list --all, intent list all exit 0. `hook session-start` exit 124.
- Full log, with every command, exit code and stdout/stderr: /tmp/holyagent-validation/command-log.txt. Drivers: /tmp/holyagent-validation/drive.sh, drive2.sh, drive3.sh, lib.sh. Fixtures: /tmp/holyagent-validation/fx (generated by /tmp/holyagent-validation/gen/gen.ts).
blockers: none. The holycodex fixtures could not be taken from github.com/davidbasilefilho/holycodex: `gh api` returned "GitHub access to this repository is not enabled for this session". I generated trees from the shapes in packages/runtime/tests/migrate.test.ts instead.
questions: none
notes:
- `--input` reads all of stdin before checking the flag, so with a pipe that never closes it blocks even for malformed JSON. Not tested: stdin non-empty together with --input (source read: context.ts payloadOf).
- The session-start hook reads stdin to EOF, so a pipe that never closes blocks it (exit 124). Claude Code sends the payload and closes stdin, so this should not occur in practice.
- `migrate --dry-run` exits 0 even when its verdict is "a real run would refuse" (holyclaude unconvertible, Running stop, conflicts after a migration). The real run exits 3.
- After migrate, `intent list` shows inUse=false for every migrated Intent (hc1, hx1). I did not run plain `assignment list` or `plan` without --all.
- The refusal for already-migrated records says "Fix them and run the command again" and its hint names a Running legacy Assignment, though all problems are "already exists".
- Blocked calls took 30s wall time because the shell waits for the `sleep 30` writer. holyagent itself was killed at 10s (exit 124).
- The dist bundle was used as found (not rebuilt). It is tracked and the tree is clean for it. The CLI ran on /root/.bun/bin/bun 1.4.4+38afee6c8 (non-canary). verify ran on the canary.
